rationale: No suitable optimization is supported for this workflow. The build job already implements dependency download caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) via actions/cache for ~/.nuget/packages keyed on packages.lock.json, which matches the pattern's method of caching dependency state while keeping installation and all required tests, so no change is needed there. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated because the workflow contains a deployment job to an Azure Web App (Development environment), and the pattern lists release/deployment work as a contraindication. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT cannot be applied because its precondition (representative successful-duration history) is not met: the repository CI history is explicitly not_a_measured_baseline with no durations, and an arbitrary timeout risks the contraindication that valid slow runs exceed the limit. Matrix-based, schedule-based, Bazel, test-selection, build-selection, and path-filter patterns either do not apply (.NET, no matrix, no schedule, push-only to main) or would risk reducing required-check coverage, which is currently unverified.
